name: Lightning
effect: Strikes the enemy with lightning for {v} HP. Blocks and dodges do not help.

name: Power Punch
effect: Turn it on and your hits deal {v}% more damage. Each strong hit costs a little mana.

name: Healing
effect: Heals you for {v} HP.

name: Nutshell Aegis
effect: Turn it on and any damage to you gets {v}% smaller. Each time it helps, it costs a little mana.

name: Toxic Spores
effect: Poisons the enemy: the next {t} {time|times} they attack, they lose {v} HP themselves. If they stop attacking, the poison runs out.

name: Snowball
effect: Hits the enemy for {v} HP and freezes them for {t} s. A frozen enemy attacks twice as slowly.

name: Stunning Shot
effect: Stuns the enemy for {t} s. They cannot attack, but they can still block.

name: Evada Kedabra
effect: For {t} s you dodge {v} enemy {hit|hits}. Hits into your block do not count.

name: Static Shield
effect: For {t} s, whoever hits you gets {v}% of that damage back.

name: Spirit Guidance
effect: Turn it on: every time the enemy moves their block, you see where it is for {t} s. Hit the other zones! Each hint costs mana.

name: Fireball
effect: Sets the enemy on fire: {v} HP right away, then the fire burns for {t} s and takes {dps} HP every second. A block does not put it out.

name: Desperate Throw
effect: Hits the enemy for {v} HP, up to 4 times harder the less health you have left. The throw costs you {r} HP, but never your last one.

name: Berserk Howl
effect: Instantly hits {v} {time|times} in a row into the zone you hit last. If the enemy blocks that zone, every hit misses. These hits do not fill your super hit.

name: Echoing Blow
effect: For {t} s each of your hits echoes and deals {v}% of its damage once more.

name: Double Down
description: Twice the pain, half the sense
effect: Your next hit is a bet: with a {v}% chance it deals 5 times the damage, otherwise it deals nothing. A won bet does not fill your super hit.

name: Asteroid
effect: Drops a rock on the enemy: {v} HP through any block, and they are stunned for {t} s.

name: Crippling Chains
effect: For {t} s the enemy cannot move their block, and you see where it is. Hit the other zones!

name: Vampire Fang
effect: For {t} s each of your hits heals you for {v}% of its damage.

name: Iron Will
effect: Turn it on: stuns, freezes, chains, poison and the enemy super hit work {v}% weaker on you, and the enemy skills slow you down less. Each time it helps, it costs a little mana.

name: Phase Shift
effect: For {t} s nothing can hurt you at all.
